Desirable:

At Huzzle , we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups and established businesses in SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech.
Unlike traditional outsourcing, you’ll be placed directly with a client as a core member of their team-giving you real ownership, career progression, and long-term stability.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary

This is a high-volume outbound sales role, ideal for someone who is comfortable making 100+ calls per day, confidently engaging decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and consistently generating sales opportunities.
The successful candidate will have 3+ years of professional experience, proven B2B sales experience, and strong hands-on knowledge of CRM systems.

• Make 100+ outbound calls per day to prospective B2B customers.
